words: Understood, Captain. I'll take the rest assignment as offered. The strain has been building, and stepping back before the next job is the sensible call.
Very well. I accept the Chief Engineer rest assignment. Better to step back and recover now than push on worn down.

project: Trim the drive to cut load
words: On it — trimming the drive load gives life support the headroom it needs. The leg runs longer and Earth's clock won't stop, but thin air scares me more than a slow transit. Let's cut the load.
Glad you handed me this one! A longer leg for safer breathing is a trade I'll take every time. I'm on the drive trim now.
You want the other reclaimers combed for the same fault before we call this fixed. No. I don't buy that it spread, and I won't march the line just to please you.
Not signing on to that. Checking every other reclaimer on the chance the fault repeated is your call to want, not mine to carry. I'm out on this one.

project: Shift the gardens to water-light crops
words: Captain, I want to back this, but before I put my name to the agreement my worry is plain: the reclaimers run short already, and the lower gardens still need water while the new crops take root.

I'm not refusing the task, Captain — I only hesitate. With the reclaimers already short, I'm unsure we can carry the lower gardens through the changeover, and I'd rather say so now than partway through the replanting.
Hold that agreement a moment, Captain. If we're recounting the stores, I'd rather do it properly than promise rations off a number I haven't checked myself.
I'm not saying no to the recount — only not yet. Let me go through the stores at my own pace first, so whatever I commit to the tally is a number I can stand behind.
Fine — you want the skeptical pass, you get it. I'll inspect the other reclaimers for that same fault before anyone calls the repair finished.
Agreed. One fault found doesn't mean the rest are clean. I'll check every other reclaimer myself before we mark this repair done.

project: Shift the gardens to water-light crops
words: With reclaimer capacity stretched that thin, I can't argue with the shift. I'll take the lower gardens and move the beds to water-light crops — carefully, so the plants don't suffer for it.
I'll take the shift to water-light crops. The reclaimers are short, and the lower gardens can carry less of the water load. I'd rather move the beds in good order than rush them.
Understood, Captain. I accept the agreement and will recount the stores myself, weight by weight, before anyone promises rations or repairs on a guess.
I'll take the recount. My word is only as good as the tally behind it, so I'll count every item the mass budget holds before we speak of rations or repairs.
Understood, Captain. I agreed to start this rest, so I'll step back now and take the recovery properly — better a rested chief than a worn one on the next job.
Very well. The rest stands as agreed. I'll get some real downtime and come back steady for the next assignment.

project: Trim the drive to cut load
words: On it, Captain - I'll ease the drive back now. Slower leg, but life support gets its headroom, and I'd rather breathe easy than race the clock.
Glad we're moving on this - trimming the drive load keeps our air comfortable. Earth's clock won't slow for us, but a safer ride beats a faster one.
